verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms llms.txt is live at https://docs.pinecone.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a clear description of the docs content, and Pinecone also documents agent-oriented integrations (MCP server, Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini CLI usage) for pointing agents at its docs/tools.
